name: EDINET
summary: Japan FSA's EDINET disclosure system: daily lists of securities filings (annual and quarterly reports, large shareholding reports) and the filings themselves as XBRL, PDF or CSV.

api_key.description: an EDINET API key, issued free after registering at api.edinet-fsa.go.jp/api/auth/index.aspx?mode=2

notes: Two steps: list a day's filings with edinet.documents.list (type=2) to get docID values, then fetch one with edinet.documents.get.
Filings are listed by file date (the day EDINET processed them), not by company; filter the list yourself by edinetCode (6 characters), secCode (5-digit securities code) or docTypeCode.
Dates may go back at most 10 years. Today's list updates about every minute from just after 08:30 JST; past dates are refreshed once a day after midnight JST.
Filer names and document descriptions are in Japanese.

endpoints.name: List filings for a date
endpoints.summary: Every filing submitted on a file date, with filer, EDINET code, securities code, document type and availability flags.

date.description: File date, YYYY-MM-DD, within the last 10 years; weekends and holidays allowed.

type.description: 1 (default) metadata only (counts); 2 the filing list plus metadata.

notes: Without type=2 only the count and update time come back, not the filings.

endpoints.name: Download a filing
endpoints.summary: One filing by docID: main document with audit report and XBRL, PDF, attachments, English files, or XBRL converted to CSV.

type.description: 1 main document, audit report and XBRL (ZIP); 2 PDF; 3 substitute and attached documents (ZIP); 4 English files (ZIP); 5 XBRL as CSV (ZIP).

notes: Returns a binary ZIP (application/octet-stream) or PDF, not JSON; errors come back as JSON.
XBRL (type 1) and CSV (type 5) exist only when the list's xbrlFlag / csvFlag is 1.
